name: myapi
description: Official MyApi plugin for Cursor and Grok Bot. Connect agents to the MyApi AI agents hub (services, memory, AFP machines, automations).

MYAPI_ENROLL_CODE.title: MyApi enroll code
MYAPI_ENROLL_CODE.description: Required unless you use a token. Single-use Quick Connect code from https://www.myapiai.com (expires in about 15 minutes). Paste in Plugins → Configure, never in chat.

MYAPI_TOKEN.title: MyApi token (optional fallback)
MYAPI_TOKEN.description: Optional. Used once to register the MCP Ed25519 keypair, or as a Bearer token when Auth mode is token. Prefer Quick Connect. Never paste long-lived tokens in chat.

MYAPI_AUTH_MODE.title: Auth mode
MYAPI_AUTH_MODE.description: asc (default): enroll/token registers a local Ed25519 key. token: every request uses MYAPI_TOKEN as Bearer.
